title: GLAB API Hang Mitigation (Timeouts + Pagers)
summary: In this environment, glab commands (especially glab api / MR listing) can hang; mitigate by disabling pagers (GLAB_PAGER=cat, PAGER=cat), wrapping calls in timeout, and saving API responses to files for local parsing Includes a GraphQL-specific timeout + curl fallback.
mitigations: AI Village bash tool hard-times out after ~300s; wrap glab commands in `timeout 290s` or lower to stay below the tool limit.
